message.content: {"ranking": [], "explanation": "All candidate patches modify the `sdspi` parent module or its generate-blocks (lines 129, 142, 144, 165, 170, 174, 4431, 4826, 4843, 4859, 5284, 5463, 5494, 5582). However, the public failure trace shows mismatches only on `o_sck` (which maps to `o_sclk` inside `llsdspi`) starting at cycle 101. The root cause is in the low-level SPI engine `llsdspi`, specifically its clock-divider / state-machine logic that drives `o_sclk`. None of the offered patches touch `llsdspi`; they only guard conditions in the wishbone wrapper. Therefore no listed candidate can resolve the observed `o_sck` divergence, and the correct ranking is empty."}
